specs.title: Booking lifecycle notifications
specs.why: Automatic confirmations and reminders are the feature merchants ask for first.
specs.scope: On booking create, confirm, cancel and reschedule, send WhatsApp to the client with SMS fallback. Owner receives aggregate events. Retry with exponential backoff and a dead-letter queue visible in admin.
tasks: Event subscribers for each lifecycle event
acceptance: Messages send for all four lifecycle events
SMS fallback triggers when WhatsApp fails
The dead-letter queue shows permanently failed messages

specs.title: Reminder scheduler
specs.why: Reminders are the single highest-leverage lever on no-show rate.
specs.scope: T-24h and T-2h reminders per booking, with a per-tenant toggle. Cron-driven with a lease lock preventing duplicate sends across restarts or multiple workers.
tasks: Lease lock using Postgres advisory locks
acceptance: No duplicate reminder across two parallel workers in test
Reminder windows are accurate to within 5 minutes
Turning the toggle off stops reminders immediately
